scope: Cross-origin response-reading protection for the tested public resource only.
limits: No real account or private account data was used or tested.
Same-site requests, cross-origin writes/CSRF, and parent-domain cookie scope are not proved safe by this test.
Isolation between mutually untrusted endpoints sharing the new gateway origin is not proved.
redaction: Operational hostnames are replaced with role-based example.invalid names; private backup paths are omitted. No registration or session secrets were recorded.
